description: Shannon is an AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes your source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before they reach production.

written.description: Reads an application's source to pick its attack paths, then attacks the running web app and its API through a browser and command-line tools. A finding reaches the report only after it has been exploited.

alive.last_commit_message:
docs: add UTM tags to keygraph.io links (#491)

Tag every keygraph.io link in the README, the npm README, and the PDF
report template with the Keygraph UTM vocabulary so Plausible can
attribute site traffic by placement.

- README.md: 7 links, utm_source=github, utm_medium=referral
- apps/cli/README.md: 3 links, utm_source=npm (shows on npm after the
  next publish)
- report.typ: keygraph-url, utm_source=shannon, utm_medium=product
  (header wordmark and cover "Tester" line in every PDF report)

All use utm_campaign=shannon_oss_2026q4; utm_content names the placement.

llms.txt, llms-full.txt and docs/ are left untagged on purpose: they are
read by AI engines, and tagged URLs there would be repeated in AI answers
and misattributed. Keep llms-full.txt untagged when regenerating it from
the README.
